payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods and protocols for evaluating segmentation quality, including comparisons with reference segments and the use of performance metrics like F-score and recall.

claims.text: Segmentation quality is evaluated by comparing automatically produced segments with manually annotated reference segments, using word pairs to represent segment borders.
An evaluation protocol was established to measure the performance of segmenters, focusing on metrics such as F-score and recall.
The evaluation process involves counting common pairs of word borders from both reference and automatically identified segments to assess accuracy.
